method: 32 fresh seeds, both sides, seven items, neutral weather, no Seals. 70% family-balanced reconstructed API opponents and 30% cross-trait proposed boards. Combat scores require exact displayed boards and are not ranked placements.
limitations: Reconstructed API lineups are reference opponents, not live human opponents.
Combat percentages are not ranked placement or completion probabilities.
Item recipes are standardized for combat; seven chosen finished recipes are not guaranteed drops.
